title: Sip & Savor Niagara: Full-Day Wine Tour with Cheese & Charcuterie
includes: Tasting fees at 4 local wineries we'll choose from the list
All taxes, fees and handling charges
Food and drinks, unless specified (not included)
Drop off at your US hotel may be available after your tour for an additional fee of $40 (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Escape the city and discover the charm of Niagara on the Lake on this full-day guided wine tour. Travel in comfort as you visit a curated selection of top, local wineries, each offering unique tastings that showcase the regions world class wines.
Between stops, take in the scenic beauty of vineyard lined roads and historic surroundings, all while enjoying a relaxed, social atmosphere, perfect for couples, friends, and visitors looking to experience the best of Niagara.
 Enhance your day with a delicious selection of gourmet cheese and charcuterie, thoughtfully paired to complement your wine tastings. With convenient pick up, a knowledgable guide, and a well paced itinerary, this experience is designed to be effortless from start to finish. 
Whether you’re new to wine or a seasoned enthusiast, this tour offers the perfect blend of flavor, scenery, and memorable moments.
